title: Notifications + Settings

backend.services/notify.py: Notification Threshold gate. Consulted ONLY when a new judgment version exists (judgment_updated) — wired via orchestrator.judgment_listeners so UI re-renders and unchanged bundles never reach it. Modes QUIET/SMART/DAILY; safety (E) overrides mode and quiet hours; quiet_hours window parsed + applied; every decision (SEND/SUPPRESS + reason) persisted to notification_decisions audit log; feed() joins SEND decisions to their Today version payload.
backend.engine/orchestrator.py: Added judgment_listeners hook fired after evaluate() only on judgment_updated.
backend.api/app.py: GET /notifications (in-app feed), GET /notifications/decisions (audit); PUT /settings validates quiet_hours format.

app.notifications_screen.dart: Sent feed + decision audit (SEND/SUPPRESS with Chinese reasons)
app.me_screen.dart: quiet_hours editor + link to notification/decision log

phase_g_cases: SMART sends only actionable (C) judgment updates; B/A/no-update suppressed
DAILY sends every judgment update but not unchanged re-renders
safety overrides quiet hours; non-safety suppressed during quiet hours
every decision audited; feed lists only SEND
threshold separation: first render + identical re-render fire no hook; real fact change fires exactly one
tests.flutter: analyze 0 errors; widget tests 5/5 PASS (FakeClient extended)

e2e_contract_cases.notification_restraint: PASS — stable/unchanged days produce zero SEND; actionable change produces exactly one SEND; all suppressions logged with reasons

transport_note: MVP transport is the in-app feed + decision log. OS-level push (Android local notifications) is a Phase H packaging item; the gate/mode/quiet-hours logic is transport-agnostic.

model_calls_paid_this_phase.note: notification gate is deterministic, zero model calls
